WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as group_avg
  FROM Examination e
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_stats
),
group_with_diff AS (
  SELECT gs.ID, gs.SEX, gs.group_avg,
         gs.group_avg - os.overall_avg as diff_from_overall
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
),
sex_stats AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(diff_from_overall) as sex_avg
  FROM group_with_diff
  GROUP BY SEX
),
final_results AS (
  SELECT gwd.ID, gwd.SEX, gwd.group_avg, gwd.diff_from_overall,
         gwd.diff_from_overall - ss.sex_avg as final_diff
  FROM group_with_diff gwd
  INNER JOIN sex_stats ss ON gwd.SEX = ss.SEX
  WHERE gwd.diff_from_overall - ss.sex_avg > ss.sex_avg
)
SELECT *
FROM final_results
ORDER BY final_diff IS NOT NULL DESC, final_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
